description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants Quad Element Mode II, [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thancred], [Leap of Faith Damage Tracker], and [Leap of Faith Level]
Quad Element Mode II: En-Holy Stack, En-Earth Stack, En-Wind Stack or En-Poison Stack

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thancred
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Leap of Faith (0~2), removed after using Leap of Faith two times

description.name: Leap of Faith Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Leap of Faith level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thancred]

description.name: Leap of Faith Level
description.text: Keeps track of Leap of Faith level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thancred]
